eoraptor-dawn-dinosaur.research_focus: current reconstructions of Eoraptor and the Late Triassic Ischigualasto landscape of Argentina
eoraptor-dawn-dinosaur.scene: A fox-sized two-legged dinosaur sprints low across a dry riverbank, a lizard-like reptile darting from its path

coelophysis-pack-hunter.research_focus: current reconstructions of Coelophysis and the Late Triassic floodplains of the American Southwest

massospondylus-southern-grazer.research_focus: current reconstructions of Massospondylus, its nests and eggs, and Early Jurassic southern Africa

dilophosaurus-twin-crest.research_focus: current scientific reconstructions of Dilophosaurus and Early Jurassic Arizona floodplains

baryonyx-fish-eating-claw.research_focus: current reconstructions of Baryonyx and the Early Cretaceous river deltas of southern England

microraptor-four-winged-glider.research_focus: current reconstructions of Microraptor, its iridescent plumage and the Early Cretaceous forests of Liaoning

deinonychus-terrible-claw.research_focus: current feathered reconstructions of Deinonychus and the Early Cretaceous landscape of Montana

spinosaurus-sailback-swimmer.research_focus: current reconstructions of Spinosaurus, its paddle-like tail, and the Cretaceous Kem Kem river systems of Morocco

carnotaurus-flesh-eating-bull.research_focus: current reconstructions of Carnotaurus and the Late Cretaceous plains of Patagonia

therizinosaurus-scythe-lizard.research_focus: current feathered reconstructions of Therizinosaurus and the Late Cretaceous river valleys of Mongolia
